title: Hunts FH-020Y: Let a resident Trail name a partner venue for a staff-confirmed stop
detail: FH-020X binds every stop and takes the venue Space from the Space that runs the Trail. A resident creates Trails as a profile owner (createTrailDraft), so the publish checklist refuses a staff-confirmed stop there (stop_staff_venue): no venue means no staff can confirm a visit or review a held one (lib/hunts/staff-queue-store.ts drops a claim with no venue). Add a per-stop venue choice limited to Spaces with an active hunt_partners row for the Hunt (authz partnerAllows), write it as the binding's venue_space_id in bindStopPlacements, and let the checklist pass when each staff-confirmed stop has one. Needs the partner invite flow or an owner decision on who may name a venue. Requires: FH-020X. Owner role: Web.
